description: Scan failure text produced by rust/wfm-core/src/acquisition and the diagnostic category the SPA reports for it. Rust checks that each source still produces text starting with `message`; the frontend checks the category and HTTP status it derives from that text.

cases.message:
Warframe doesn't appear to be running.
Start the game, log past the title screen, then retry.

No accountId/nonce pair found in WF memory.
Make sure you're past the login screen and a recent network
call has fired (opening the trade or profile screen is reliable).

No accountId/nonce pair found in WF memory.
Make sure you're past the login screen and a recent network
call has fired (opening the trade or profile screen is reliable).

The configured cred pattern matched 2 time(s), but capture groups 1 and 2 did not both participate, so no value can be read.

Inventory endpoint returned HTTP 403 Forbidden (12 bytes).

If the response was small or 4xx, DE may have rotated something.

Inventory endpoint returned HTTP 404 Not Found (9 bytes).

If the response was small or 4xx, DE may have rotated something.
a memory scan is already in progress; retry in a moment
Permission denied reading /proc/1/mem - reading the game's memory needs
OpenProcess failed - not running as same user, or pid is wrong
